name: Glow Trail
description: A firefly leaves a short glowing trail across a night garden. Collect dew drops to grow it. Bumping never ends anything: the trail just eases back.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A firefly glides across a grid leaving a glowing trail. Steer it to the dew drops to make the trail longer.
help.goal: Grow the longest trail you can in a calm round of 2 minutes. Touching your own trail or the edge never ends the game: the trail simply shortens back to its starting length and you carry on.
howToPlay: Steer the firefly with the arrow keys. It keeps gliding in the direction you chose.
Glide over a dew drop to collect it. Each drop makes the trail one cell longer.
If you touch your own trail or the edge, the trail shortens back to its starting length. Nothing else is lost.
After 2 minutes of play the round ends and shows your longest trail and your best. Pausing stops the clock.
Turn on Slower for a gentler pace. Press Play again for a new garden.

controls.action: Start or resume after the Ready prompt
Reach the Up, Left, Down, Right, Slower and New round buttons

tips: Wide, lazy turns keep the trail out of your way.
Slower gives you more time to plan each turn.
You can stop at any time. Your round is saved and waits for you.
